findings.problem: Ultra planFeature reads 'The flagship Claude model on every tailoring, not just the fast one (coming soon)'. The 'not just the fast one' clause asserts a false CURRENT state: every tailoring already runs claude-opus-4-8 (the flagship) via the single global resolveLlmProvider/getLlmModel (shared/lib/llm/factory.ts, claude.ts DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL). There is no per-plan model, no 'fast' tier for free/Pro. The copy tells users today's product uses a lesser model, which is untrue.
findings.fix: Drop the 'not just the fast one' clause (align with the billing/landing wording) and/or reframe so it does not claim a model tier that does not exist.

findings.problem: 'The flagship Claude model on every tailoring (coming soon)' (also en.ts:566, ua.ts:137/177/570) marks flagship-model-on-every-tailoring as a coming-soon Ultra differentiator, but claude-opus-4-8 (flagship) is already shipped for EVERY plan (no model-tier architecture). Marking a shipped reality 'coming soon' is the audit's own 'hiding a shipped feature' case; the intended per-plan differentiator does not exist in code.
findings.fix: Either remove the flagship-model line entirely (no model tiering exists) or reword to a clearly future per-plan differentiator that does not imply current tailorings run a lesser model.
